description: Implementation of the HpackHeaderTable class for managing HPACK header compression table, including methods for lookup, insertion, eviction, and size management.

classes.name: HpackHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the HPACK header table with static and dynamic entries, supporting lookup, insertion, eviction, and size control.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a header by name, searching static and dynamic tables.

methods.name: GetByNameAndValue
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a header by name and value, searching static and dynamic tables.

methods.name: SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the header table and evicts entries if necessary.

methods.name: SetSettingsHeaderTableSize
methods.description: Updates the size bound based on settings and adjusts table size accordingly.

methods.name: EvictionSet
methods.description: Determines the range of entries to evict based on header name and value.

methods.name: EvictionCountForEntry
methods.description: Calculates how many entries need to be evicted to accommodate a new header entry.

methods.name: EvictionCountToReclaim
methods.description: Calculates the number of entries to evict to reclaim a specified size.

methods.name: Evict
methods.description: Removes a specified number of entries from the dynamic table.

methods.name: TryAddEntry
methods.description: Attempts to add a new header entry to the dynamic table, evicting as needed.
